verdict.rationale: SES offers a genuine free tier (3,000 messages/month free for 12 months) plus a pay-as-you-go model with no contracts, and its sandbox specifically supports testing real message delivery to verified addresses (which can be a founder's own users) before requesting production access to send to any real recipient without demo restrictions (docs-13,14,18,41,42). This is more than a canned demo — it's the same production sending pipeline gated by verification/approval rather than a separate sandbox product. However, community reports flag friction: unpredictable production-access approval times, deliverability/blacklist issues, and account suspension risk on high bounce rates, which can complicate 'real user' validation in practice (comm-9,12,16). Missing for 10: documented SLA/turnaround for sandbox-to-production approval, and independent confirmation that new founders can reliably reach real inboxes during the trial without deliverability friction.
